title: Warm Moroccan Sherry Molcajete Amlou
description: A comforting Moroccan dish featuring sherry, served in a traditional molcajete. Rich, fatty, and tender, this amlou is a perfect treat for a cold evening.
instructions: Soak the almonds and hazelnuts in water for at least 8 hours.
Drain and rinse the nuts, then grind them into a fine paste using a molcajete or food processor.
In a medium saucepan, heat the almond milk over low heat.
Add the sherry, honey, butter, rosewater, vanilla extract, and salt to the saucepan. Stir until the honey dissolves.
Add the ground nut paste to the saucepan and stir constantly over low heat for 10 minutes, or until the mixture thickens.
Transfer the mixture to a clean molcajete and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the mixture for at least 2 hours before serving.
